invariant: PlantUML paints SVEK leaves in GraphvizImageBuilder construction order, which is namespace traversal order rather than one global constructor-ID order. buildImage calls printGroups before getUnpackagedEntities. For each nonempty group, printGroup creates that group's direct leaves in quark creation order, then recurses through child groups in group creation order. Empty package groups enter that child-group traversal as leaf nodes. Only after every root group is complete are unpackaged root leaves created. CommandFactoryNoteOnEntity creates its NOTE as a real leaf in the current namespace, so attached and floating notes participate in the same per-namespace direct-leaf order. Bibliotekon and SvekResult preserve this construction stream through painting.
causal_divergence: Rust's package traversal stream contains ordinary entities and empty-package leaves but excludes notes. The first implementation then globally sorts notes by reconstructed ent ID and merges that monotonic stream into a package-first entity stream whose IDs are deliberately non-monotonic across package/root boundaries. A root note with an early ID is therefore painted before a later-created packaged entity that Java constructs first; the reverse crossing leaves a packaged note behind an earlier-ID root entity. Attached notes are also appended to the layout graph after ordinary leaves instead of entering the same namespace traversal.
planned_change: Record each note constructor event's current package identity. Extend the existing SVEK node-emission traversal to include attached and floating notes among their owning package's direct leaves in constructor order, while preserving direct leaves before child groups and all root groups before root leaves. Use that single traversal stream for both LayoutGraph node creation and no-oracle SVG painting. Keep cpt1 UID allocation orthogonal: IDs retain constructor order even when paint order crosses them.
perturbation_axes: attached notes before, between, and after ordinary declarations
relationship-created endpoints interleaved with attached notes
floating and attached notes mixed in both orders
left, right, top, and bottom note positions

rejected_attempt.result: Rejected because globally merging notes by ent ID contradicts GraphvizImageBuilder's package-first, root-last construction traversal.
